findings.summary: Forcing PagingMode::Never for --list-themes reverts paging that was deliberately added (#3239, fixed in #3457) and overrides explicit --paging=always
No CHANGELOG entry, which CONTRIBUTING.md requires and CI enforces
Change was never compiled or tested; PR body reads in agent voice about its sandbox
Override leaves the existing list-themes guard at app.rs:304-306 dead; should be handled inside the match

why: Finding 1 states the maintainer's reason directly: paging for --list-themes was added on purpose and force-disabling it reverses that choice.
